    ConfluentWireFormat
    The five-byte header Confluent's serializers put in front of every schema-registered payload: a zero magic byte, then the schema id as a four-byte big-endian integer, then the encoded value.

    SchemaDiff

    One field's difference.
    SchemaRegistryClient
    A small client for a Confluent-style Schema Registry REST API (list subjects/versions, fetch a schema by subject+version or by id, and register a new schema version).
    SchemaRegistryClient.Schema
    A registered schema version.
    SchemaRegistryJson
    A minimal, dependency-free JSON reader/writer covering exactly what the SchemaRegistryClient needs from Confluent Schema Registry responses: arrays of strings, arrays of integers, and flat objects whose values are strings (one of which — the schema field — is itself an escaped JSON document) or numbers.

NexusLink — one console, every protocol, zero context switching.
